crossRefs.note: We are all one man’s sons; we are honest men. Your servants are not spies.”

translations.web: We said to him, ‘We are honest men. We are no spies.
translations.bsb: But we told him, ‘We are honest men, not spies.
translations.kjv: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies:
translations.asv: And we said unto him, We are true men; and we are no spies:
